experiments.hypothesis: Machine-enforcing a real 10-14 minute plan for WORKING authority will prevent silent early termination.
experiments.result: Plan validity and CI enforcement succeeded, but epoch 16 meaningful progress stopped after 145 seconds and remained absent until successor observation.
experiments.lesson: Plan enforcement is necessary for truthful state but cannot produce runtime liveness.

experiments.hypothesis: Separating wake source, worker lifetime, durable continuation and measurement will localize the utilization ceiling and reveal a better wake/runtime adapter.
implemented: event-wake candidate contract and dedupe ledger
experiments.live_test: Measure epoch 17 invocation span and successor gap; do not infer work from missing evidence.

experiments.hypothesis: A supported ChatGPT Work GitHub PR event trigger can reduce continuation latency materially below the quarter-wake baseline without paid API or always-on PC.
experiments.success_gate: 3 safe cycles, zero recursive triggers, zero duplicate substantive executions, monotonic authority, and median event-to-first-work materially below quarter baseline.

rule: Do not repeat a falsified experiment as the primary intervention without new evidence that changes its causal premise.
